name: research
description: Topic-bound research producing a durable cited brief with bidirectional companion ensemble (Claude ↔ Codex)

interface.longDescription: Conducts focused research on a topic and produces a durable cited brief. Runs a bidirectional companion ensemble: when invoked on Codex, calls claude-companion for a Claude peer perspective; when invoked on Claude, calls codex-companion for a Codex peer perspective. Output saved as ./output/YYYY-MM-DD_<topic-slug>/research_brief.md.
